## History

Minnie May is the young sister of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). When her parents are away, she becomes dangerously ill with croup, prompting [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to run to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for urgent assistance. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

Minnie May's life was saved by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when she fell dangerously ill with croup while their parents were away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was able to successfully treat the condition using her prior experience with young children, earning the immense gratitude of the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) family. This heroic act resolved previous tensions and led Minnie May's mother to fully forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow her to resume her close friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
